customers_say: Customers find the water purifier provides good taste and clean output, with positive feedback about installation, service, and value for money. However, the reliability and durability receive mixed reviews - while some say it works well, others report it stops working after 4 months and won't last more than a year. Moreover, opinions are divided on water wastage, with some claiming zero waste while others consider it a gimmick.

reviews.author: Caleb
reviews.title: Super product...extra charges only needs to be communicated
reviews.body: Ajaz ,the technician was on time, assembled within 24 hours of delivery. Kent always can be trusted. Only thing, they should mention PRV and filter costs extra Rs.2400 ...while purchasing. It is okay as a one time cost. Just keep transparency while billing. Anyways..good product!

reviews.author: Worst Product/ Donot Buy
reviews.title: Defective product received/ No replacement policy
reviews.body: Product didnot work during Installation on 16th October. When requested Amazon, it diverted the call to Kent to get the product serviced instead of replacement. Kent local dealer visited multiple times , but unable to fix the problem. Finally they have take the product to the service center after 10 days of delivery. The area sales manager dont pickup my calls. Worst product and replacement policy. I am very much disappointed.

reviews.title: 1300 for compulsory new external filter
reviews.body: I already have one external filter, but they insist on adding new external filter, they mention they won't connect to other brands and charged 1300 for new filter.
